name: softenant-video-studio
description: Edit Windows video projects, mix audio, render previews and export through a local MCP service.

interface.shortDescription: Control the Windows video editor with MCP.
interface.longDescription: Create and edit timeline projects, mix music, add titles, preview and export MP4. Screen recording is available when enabled on the Windows PC.
interface.defaultPrompt: List my media and help me edit a video with Softenant Video Studio.
